purpose: macOS-specific UX/UI design guide that consolidates Apple HIG guidance for macOS: pointer and keyboard input, navigation, window management, layout, components, UX patterns and a checklist.
summary: Pointer and keyboard input model: click targets, cursors, shortcuts
Navigation patterns: menu bar, toolbar, sidebar, inspector, tabs
Window management: window styles, full screen, layout patterns
Layout: information density, spacing standards, text sizes versus iOS
Standard macOS components: controls, content display, navigation
macOS UX patterns: system integration, drag and drop, multi-selection, undo/redo
Evaluation checklist for pointer, keyboard, menu bar, windows, density, accessibility
tasks: Designing or analyzing macOS app UI
Mapping a design to HIG standard components
Reviewing menu bar and keyboard shortcut design
Reviewing window management and layout of a macOS design
Creating design tokens for a macOS app
title: macOS プラットフォームガイド
